available_review_only_evidence: Family expansion maps one expert-reviewed NDK boundary row, m_csa:637, as out_of_scope rather than a seed-fingerprint training label.
Current geometry retrieval routes m_csa:637 through metal_dependent_hydrolase top1 at 0.4066, below the calibrated 0.4115 floor and not source-free NDK evidence.
Four homolog controls, 1WKL, 3Q86, 9OAN, and 9PFY, carry gamma-capable nucleotide plus Mg context and measured gamma-to-mapped-histidine distances of 2.899-3.339 Angstrom.
The same homolog controls also show same-chain hydroxyl distances of 3.487-5.240 Angstrom, which documents the hydroxyl-axis confusion risk instead of licensing a production scorer.
blocked_or_missing_evidence: No accepted source-free NDK fold or phosphohistidine axis exists in production code.
No calibrated policy separates catalytic histidine transfer from generic nearby hydroxyl residues across current production fingerprints.
No NDK threshold, external hard-negative re-audit, or countable positive seed set exists.
The four homolog rows were generated as ePK sibling counteraxis evidence and cannot be reused as import or production-positive evidence without a separate gated cycle.
